name: supervision_session_workflows
create_sql:
CREATE TABLE supervision_session_workflows (
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	checks JSONB NOT NULL, 
	phase_plans JSONB NOT NULL, 
	started_by VARCHAR(64), 
	ended_by VARCHAR(64), 
	end_note TEXT, 
	archived_report_id VARCHAR(36), 
	archived_fingerprint VARCHAR(64), 
	archived_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES eval_sessions (session_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(archived_report_id) REFERENCES supervision_session_reports (report_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: supervision_session_journal
create_sql:
CREATE TABLE supervision_session_journal (
	journal_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	note TEXT NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	detail JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (journal_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES eval_sessions (session_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
